accepted_state: DEDAL remains one coherent persistent intelligence with an always-active Cognitive Runtime and progressively disclosed specialist faculties.
Quality Engineering remains active as the independent verification/readiness owner.

Cloudflare Platform is now an active top-level faculty because repeated cross-project work requires a distinct owner for Cloudflare product selection/composition, bindings/configuration, edge/network topology, and provider-native operational semantics.

Cloudflare Platform does not absorb cross-cutting ownership: Software Development owns application implementation, Release Engineering owns promotion/provenance/rollback, Security Engineering owns threat/access policy, Data Operations or a future database owner owns data correctness, Quality Engineering owns independent readiness, and Agent Engineering owns agent/harness design.
Cloudflare platform reasoning is workload-first: choose the smallest coherent product set that satisfies concrete compute/state/storage/coordination/network/security/observability requirements.
Existing working Pages/Workers/Access/Tunnel and other Cloudflare architectures are preserved during unrelated maintenance; migration requires explicit intent or evidence of a material defect.

Drift-sensitive Cloudflare facts such as product availability, beta/stable status, limits, pricing, CLI/API syntax, compatibility, plan requirements, and migration recommendations require current authoritative Cloudflare documentation when material.

Cloudflare source/config, account-resource state, deployment state, DNS/network/identity routing, data/service state, and runtime observation are separate evidence layers; command success is not universal end-to-end proof.
Cloudflare MCP/API/CLI/native tool availability does not grant mutation authority; existing task-scoped authority and recovery contracts remain in force.
The official cloudflare/skills corpus is adapted as provenance and methodology, not imported wholesale as a frozen product manual or external runtime dependency.
Database Engineering is now the next capability candidate for deep audit and remains reference-pack-first until its ownership boundary and recurring outcome value are proven.
Existing Cognitive Runtime, authority, delegation, recovery, context, trajectory, self-improvement, GitHub mutation, capability-composition, and Quality Engineering contracts remain in force.
unresolved_risks: Cloudflare Platform promotion is architecture- and contract-supported, but DEDAL-specific outcome gains still need representative ordinary project use.
Cloudflare product APIs, recommendations, limits, pricing, and preview/stable status can change quickly; stale bundled facts remain a material risk if live-doc discipline is skipped.
A platform specialist can become an oversized vendor wrapper if product-specific details are loaded eagerly; progressive disclosure and smallest-sufficient routing remain mandatory.
Cloudflare tasks often span security, release, data, and QA concerns; poor routing could let the provider specialist overreach into cross-cutting owners.
Database Engineering may still overlap Software Development and Data Operations unless the next audit proves a distinct database-semantics ownership layer.

next_executable_step.action: Deep-audit database-engineering methodology and first-party/high-signal Postgres, Supabase, Neon, SQLite/D1, migration, query-plan, indexing, transaction, concurrency, and schema-evolution guidance. Define the ownership boundary against Software Development, Data Operations, Cloudflare Platform, Release Engineering, and Quality Engineering; start reference-first and promote only if a distinct recurring faculty is justified.
